title: A Unified Anomaly Synthesis Strategy with Gradient Ascent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Localization (GLASS)
mechanism: Global feature-level anomaly synthesis by gradient ascent with hypersphere truncation plus local image-level synthesis, covering weak near-normal defects; a discriminator outputs the map.
adaptation: (a) Benchmark AD row trained per source on clean pool cells. (b) Auxiliary binary head on the house encoder using GAS-perturbed non-crack features as hard samples, aimed at the 7% of crack components under 2% contrast. About 150 lines of new code.
evidence: R: MVTec AD detection AUROC 99.9; SOTA on VisA, MPDD; weak-defect and woven-fabric industrial validation.
min_experiment: Arm: house + GAS aux head (weight 0.1); baseline: house. Metric: CV crack recall on components < 2% contrast, crack IoU. Kill: low-contrast recall gain < +0.05 or crack IoU drop > 0.01.
prior_overlap: none; crack copy-paste (n.d.) was image-level real-crack pasting, not feature-space synthesis.
